name: Pefferlaw–Beaverton
description: Short-lived rural connector replacing the northern end of the former Sutton route 69. It later passed to York Region Transit as route 51.

timeline.event: GO introduced route 80 between Pefferlaw and Beaverton.
The launch schedule offered nine weekday trips in each direction and three on weekend days.
The YRT service-change notice still refers to connections with GO route 80.
The original YRT system map shows route 51 Beaverton–Pefferlaw in the former GO corridor.

gaps: The transfer to YRT occurred in 2013, after the February connection notice and by the September system map; exact final GO service date remains unverified.
